answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 14 credits, frozen until 21 days after the grading closes is the price, and the pulse never covers it twice. No Flagonbound burgundy inspector vine licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence burgundy inspectors carry after wine office audits is why it holds. One opal, one entry. The tally keeps ripple.
